title: OpenAPI Events — manual listing order
description: data/events.order.yml — event slugs pinned to the FRONT of every listing, in the order given. Anything not listed falls back to date order (finished events most-recent-first). Upcoming events are pinned here soonest-first; finished ones are intentionally left out so they self-order.

items.description: An event's data/<year>/<slug>/ folder name. A slug that matches no event is simply ignored.
